about.text: Mahón cheese is a soft to hard white cheese made from cows' milk, named after the town and natural port of Mahón, on the island of Menorca off the Mediterranean coast of Spain. Menorca is known for its cheese production.

how.label: press in cloth
how.text: The curd is gathered in a knotted square cloth and pressed, which gives the cushion-shaped square with a 'mamella' crease on top. Rubbing the rind with butter, olive oil or oil and paprika stops it drying out too fast and gives its orange-brown colour, while long ripening makes it sharper.
